crossRefs.note: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
Which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.
By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

translations.web: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
translations.bsb: From whose womb does the ice emerge? Who gives birth to the frost from heaven,
translations.kjv: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered
translations.asv: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
